summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature. Changes: rich/progress.py (private reader and context wrapper, module-level open and wrap_file after track(), Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file after Progress.track); tests/test_progress.py (20 new tests before the __main__ block); docs/source/progress.rst (two subsections under Advanced usage); CHANGELOG.md (one Added entry linking PR 1759). Not run: tests, mypy, black, since repo code execution was prohibited. Nothing committed. Design choices: the context wrapper subclasses typing.ContextManager[Any] so module-level wrap_file type-checks without a suppression; text versus binary is decided on the raw mode string, so 'tr' is binary; a catch-all mode: str overload was added to both open entry points.
